Body.Content:
Desktop flows will support direct triggers, enabling automations to start in response to supported events without requiring an intermediary cloud flow. This simplifies automation design and reduces the effort required to connect desktop flows to business processes.

GA date: March CY2027

Preview date: January CY2027
